messages:
anya: Quick flag — during the canary for payments-service the promoted chart (2.14.0) pulled a different ConfigMap than staging. values-prod.yaml shows `feature_flags.payment_v2: true` but the cluster has `false`.
morgan: ugh, is that the configmap name collision again? which key differs exactly?
anya: yes, keys: `payment_v2` and `cert_rotate_mode`. In prod values we set `cert_rotate_mode: staggered` but the canary pods read `immediate` (from an older overlay).
morgan: deploy-bot reported 3x transient 503s for the canary pods 5m after start, maybe related to the mismatch.
deploy-bot: Canary for payments-service chart=2.14.0 started in eu-west-1 (10 nodes). Observed 3x 503 at 2026-03-21T08:04Z, CPU/mem normal, readiness flaps on pod/pmts-connector-2.
ryan: @anya can you paste the `kubectl get configmap` diff? may be overlay/helm release got stale.
anya: here's a quick diff:
```
# values-prod.yaml
feature_flags:
  payment_v2: true
cert_rotate_mode: staggered
# configmap currently on cluster (from 2.13.9)
feature_flags:
  payment_v2: false
cert_rotate_mode: immediate
```
jen: sounds like a values merge race during the chart promotion. Did the promotion pipeline apply any preflight hooks that mutate the configmap?
anya: nothing in the hooks — the release pipeline only applies the chart; the configmap is a templated resource in the chart (not external). I suspect a stale values secret in eu-west overlay repo.
morgan: conservative plan: pin the deployment to chart 2.13.9 in eu-west and pause the 2.14.0 promotion until we fix overlays. That avoids a full rollback and keeps other regions promotable.
ryan: +1 to pin. can we pin the releasebot to keep traffic on 2.13.9 for eu-west only?
jen: also need a short blurb for release notes: "post-canary config drift detected in eu-west, pinned chart version in-region pending values merge" — ops needs to be aware.
anya: I can open a quick PR to fix overlay and add an admission preflight to check `cert_rotate_mode` consistency. ETA ~30m.
morgan: steps: 1) annotate the eu-west release as pinned 2) instruct deploy-bot to pause further rollouts in eu-west 3) QA overlay fix 4) promote after green.
anya: annotating now:
```
kubectl annotate helmrelease payments-service eu-west pinned-chart=2.13.9 --overwrite
```
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Pausing automated promotion for payments-service in eu-west-1. Canary continuing in other regions.
ryan: can you also add a short smoke check to confirm `cert_rotate_mode: staggered` after the overlay PR?
anya: will add `kubectl get configmap -o yaml` check into the post-merge CI smoke. PR in ~20m.
jen: thumbs up. I'll update the release notes draft and ping support to hold any upgrade requests from customers in eu-west.
morgan: decision logged — pin eu-west to 2.13.9, pause automated promotion, fix overlay, add preflight check, re-promote after QA. Thanks.
anya: thanks all. I'll report back when PR merged. :white_check_mark:
